judged_text: The PR rewrites loadUsers wholesale — new dynamicUserList validation, a try/catch remapping errors to HttpError 400/500, and a Prisma select that drops the previous `organization: { select: { slug: true } }` — none of which is traceable to the destinationCalendar multi-host fix. Anyone approving this PR as a calendar fix silently signs off on changed user-loading semantics for every booking: empty/missing dynamicUserList now aborts with 500 'Unable to load users' instead of returning an empty list, server-side Prisma known-request errors are re-reported as client 400s, and any consumer of the loaded users' organization.slug on the dynamic-link path now reads undefined.
